description: Shoppers report a broken store experience across search, cart, and checkout. Typing tea in search may not find Herbal Tea. The Beverages category filter can show no products. Cart line totals and subtotal ignore quantity when adding the same item twice. Coupon SAVE10 says it applied but the discount stays $0.00. Remove may clear the wrong rows; decreasing quantity can increase it instead. Checkout Pay now stays disabled with items in the cart, and payment can fail with invalid amount for normal orders.
expectedOutcome: Search tea shows Herbal Tea. Beverages filter shows tea and syrup. Two Herbal Teas cost $24.00 on the line and subtotal. SAVE10 gives $2.40 off ($21.60 total). Remove and quantity buttons behave correctly. Checkout enables Pay now and payment succeeds.
hint: Work in order: fix catalog search/filter → cart math and coupon → quantity/remove → checkout. Run npm run test:e2e after each area. Reproduce with search tea, category Beverages, add tea twice, coupon SAVE10.
solution: Fix search (case-insensitive includes in productFilters), category match (compare to Beverages not lowercase), cart subtotal and line totals (price × qty), coupon percent 10 on SAVE10, removeItem filter !== id, decrement subtracts 1, canPay when items and totalDue > 0, drop totalCents > 500 cap in checkoutClient.
playwrightTests: E2E fails until catalog, cart, coupon, quantity, remove, checkout, and payment are all fixed; passes on main.
